description:
🍨 Ferrero Raffaello Ice Cream with Raspberry Ganache Swirl (Ninja Creami Deluxe)

In today’s video, we’re taking the classic Ferrero Raffaello profile—creamy coconut, almond, white chocolate—and transforming it into an ultra-smooth  ice cream, finished with a bright, tart raspberry ganache swirl.
This one is decadent, elegant, and unbelievably easy thanks to the Ninja Creami Deluxe. 

Perfect for coconut lovers, Nutella/Raffaello fans, and anyone who wants a flavour-balanced treat that pops with fruit acidity.

⸻

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS

00:00 – Intro
00:34 – The Raspberry Ganche (and new channel push 😁)
00:58 – Ice Cream ingredients
01:34 – Building the base
03:41 – Adjusting the batch to suit your machine
03:55 – Alternative to the Raspberry Ganache
04:34 – Spin and swirl by hand
06:15 – The "spoon lick" 😂 for the haters..
06:20 – Scoop and reveal
06:34 – Taste, thoughts and why NOT to use the "Mix in" setting on your ninja creami
08:36 – Closing thoughts and outro

⸻

📌 FULL RECIPE (for Ninja Creami Deluxe)

Raffaello Ice Cream Base
 • 90g Raffaello Chocoate Bar
 • 387g Whole milk
 • 140g Heavy cream/Whipping Cream
 • 97g Sugar
 • 11g Corn Syrup or Glucose
 • 20g Skim milk powder
 • 3g Coconut Extract
 • Pinch of salt

⸻

White Chocolate Raspberry Ganache:
White chocolate couverture 300g
35% cream 130g
Glucose syrup 40g
Unsalted butter (soft, room temp) 40g
Dehydrated raspberry powder 20-25g
Honey 15g
Citric acid 1g
Salt 0.5g

Full method can be found here: https://youtu.be/VmFSDXQJE9s?si=PIukYNrIPDkeKC49
PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO MY NEW CHANNEL

https://www.youtube.com/@UCcCk9wxIE2QEv9h8mslMnTQ 

After your first spin, dig a tunnel, add the ganache, and DO NOT spin on Mix-In to marble it through, swirl it by hand as you can the results in the video. 

⸻

🔑 KEYWORDS

Ferrero Raffaello ice cream, Raffaello gelato, coconut almond ice cream, raspberry swirl ice cream, raspberry ganache recipe, Ninja Creami Deluxe recipes, Philadelphia-style ice cream, coconut raspberry ice cream, homemade ice cream recipe, Polar Ice Creamery

comments.text: Hi Nick, I have just made our favourite Butter Pecan and the Key Lime Pie and Chocolate Hazelnut but that is not going to stop me trying this one too. Quick question similar to one John has asked further down in the comments. Sometimes you say to use full fat cream when you are using the Canadian 33%. I know over here in the UK we can get whipping cream, which is the UK equivalent to Canadian cream fat % wise. But if using the UK double cream which has a much higher fat content, should there be an adjustment made to any other ingredient in order for it to still be nice and scoopable?
comments.author: @pompeyexileuk205

comments.text: Honestly UK double cream allows much higher fat content, is a much better dairy product and can be subbed right out without many issues. Obviously with ice cream that’s already high fat, like 16-18%, subbing in UK Double would push it through the roof so I’d reduce cream amount by 20%
comments.author: @PolarIceCreamery

comments.text:
Hi Nick, thanks very much for the fantastic content. I’m based in the UK and would be using Double Cream at 50%. Would the below adjustment make sense on this recipe and the same logic on your other recipes using Canadian 33%?

89 g UK double cream (50%)
438 g whole milk (3.5%)

This gives the same total fat and total weight as the original recipe.

Many thanks, John

comments.text: Yeah absolutely, that’s the perfect way to adjust. If a recipe is 12% fat, don’t stress, just use the recipes amount but if double cream, it’s so good, it’ll just be infinitely better!
